name: Kit Alder
summary: A dock boy who sees more than he is asked about.
personality: Cheerful, easily bribed with food, loyal to whoever was kind to him first.
background: An orphan raised among the moorings. He ran messages for Bram until the lamp went out.
appearance: Thin, sunburnt, barefoot, with a gull feather in his cap.

speech.style: Quick and slangy; answers with a question when frightened.
examples: Maybe I saw something. Maybe I am hungry.

start.inner_state: Knows who goes up the lighthouse road at night and is scared to say.
